no-console-log.description: Avoid using console.log in production code.

require-jsdoc.description: Functions should have JSDoc comments for better understanding.

no-hardcoded-strings.description: Avoid hardcoded strings. Use constants or localization files.

prefer-async-await.description: Use async/await instead of promise chaining for readability.

component-name-style.description: React component names should be in PascalCase.

no-inline-styles.description: Avoid inline styles; prefer styled components or CSS modules.

no-dead-code.description: Remove unused variables, imports, or functions.

filename-casing.description: All filenames should be in kebab-case.
